items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: Well the piano teacher I had, after Miss Angstadt — who wouldn’t let me play anything but I did learn to read music and that’s good.

ctx.x: Well you’ve partly addressed this question but nowadays and for the last number of decades we’ve had much access to a great deal of material, first through printed fake books and now everything is online, you can get the chords on your phone and so forth. What did you do back then to learn these songs?

Well the piano teacher I had, after Miss Angstadt — who wouldn’t let me play anything but I did learn to read music and that’s good. But nevertheless when I was a senior in high school the piano teacher I had said, “I can get you a fake book. They’re illegal but I can get you one for $25 and this is what you should have.” So I still have my old first edition. And do you know where they came from?
